svg.title: Infinite Ramsey thinning
svg.desc: Schematic nested infinite reservoirs V0,V1,V2. Edges from wi to every vertex in Vi have its base colour di. The displayed colours are illustrative; infinite pigeonhole yields infinitely many indices with one common base colour.
